assessment: This study has fundamental findings that support the potential application of exogenous stem cell therapy as a viable therapeutic option for the management of intraocular pressure (IOP) and to increase outflow facility. The evidence supporting the clinical application of stem cells is compelling, using a combination of established in vivo and ex vivo experimental techniques. The work will be of interest to both basic stem cell biologists and clinical glaucoma specialists.
